Summarise COVID-19 deaths by SEIFA Quintile in Australia

summarise_seifa_deaths.Rd

Calculates the total number of registered COVID-19 deaths for each SEIFA Quintile across one or more specified years. If no years are provided, deaths are summarised across the entire available period (2020-2024).

Usage

summarise_seifa_deaths(data = covid_seifa, years = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing SEIFA Quintile, year, and deaths. Defaults to the included covid_seifa dataset.

years

An integer vector specifying the years to include in the summary. Defaults to NULL, which includes all available years.

Value

A data frame containing each SEIFA Quintile and its corresponding total number of COVID-19 deaths for the specified years, arranged in descending order of deaths.

Examples

# Summarise deaths in 2020
summarise_seifa_deaths(years = 2020)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 2
#>   `SEIFA Quintile`        deaths
#>   <fct>                    <dbl>
#> 1 1 (most disadvantaged)     289
#> 2 2                          239
#> 3 5 (least disadvantaged)    140
#> 4 3                          128
#> 5 4                          106

# Summarise deaths across 2020 and 2021
summarise_seifa_deaths(years = c(2020, 2021))
#> # A tibble: 5 × 2
#>   `SEIFA Quintile`        deaths
#>   <fct>                    <dbl>
#> 1 1 (most disadvantaged)     869
#> 2 2                          546
#> 3 3                          336
#> 4 4                          266
#> 5 5 (least disadvantaged)    236

# Summarise deaths across all available years
summarise_seifa_deaths()
#> # A tibble: 5 × 2
#>   `SEIFA Quintile`        deaths
#>   <fct>                    <dbl>
#> 1 1 (most disadvantaged)    5361
#> 2 2                         4131
#> 3 3                         3145
#> 4 4                         2569
#> 5 5 (least disadvantaged)   1921
